## What lives here
The platform settings shown on the Settings page: the definitions, the persisted overrides, model-catalog handling, and the proxy to the Tool Service's settings.

## Conventions
`core.py` must stay identical to `tool-service/app/runtime_config.py`; it has already drifted, with an extra `json` type. Each setting declares `used_in` and `impact`.

## Entry points
`store.get_store()`, used by `config.py`, and `routes/settings.py`.
